name: Voibe Work
tagline: Bot-free meeting notes and dictation for Mac and Windows, with notes stored on your computer.
bestFor: Individuals who want dictation and bot-free meeting notes in one desktop app
description: Voibe Work adds meeting notes to the Voibe dictation app. It records your microphone and the meeting audio on your computer, so no bot joins the call, and saves the summary and transcript locally. It costs $19 per month, or $149 per year ($12.42 a month) at list price.
pros: No bot joins the call; works with Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Webex and Slack huddles
Transcripts and summaries are saved on your computer and meeting audio is deleted after processing
One seat covers one Mac and the same person's Windows PC
cons: No native CRM, Notion or calendar integration listed; Voibe Meeting MCP is the main way to export data to other tools
Team admin features need Enterprise, which starts above 10 seats and is quote-only
freePlanDetails: Voibe Free covers dictation with a weekly word limit on one Mac or Windows device. The pricing page does not list meeting notes on the free plan. Users drop to Free after the 30-day Voibe Work trial.
trial: 30-day trial of Voibe Work, no credit card

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Dictation only, limited words. Meeting notes not listed.

plans.name: Voibe Dictation
plans.notes: Dictation only, no meeting notes. $74.25 per year on the current offer (list $99, 25% off); per-month figure derived. Lifetime $199.

plans.name: Voibe Work
plans.notes: Dictation plus unlimited meeting notes. $111.75 per year on the current offer (list $149, 25% off); per-month figure derived. Lifetime $399. 30-day money-back guarantee.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: More than 10 seats. Team admin, central billing and invoicing, custom terms, BAA on request.

integrations: Records Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Webex, Slack huddles and other meeting apps; Voibe Meeting MCP for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Claude Code
compliance: Local storage of transcripts and summaries

sources.label: Voibe Help: What's in Voibe Work (Essence AI Ltd.)

launch.what: Voibe launched Voibe Work, a plan that adds bot-free meeting notes to its dictation app; Voibe Meeting MCP followed in October 2026.

name: Wispr Flow Notetaker
tagline: Bot-free meeting notetaker built into the Wispr Flow dictation app.
bestFor: People who already dictate with Wispr Flow and want meeting notes in the same app
description: Wispr Flow Notetaker records Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and Slack huddle calls from your device, shows a live transcript and writes notes on decisions and tasks. It is included in Wispr Flow plans, from a limited free tier to Pro at $15 per user per month, or $12 billed annually.
pros: Included on the free plan with speaker identification and meeting Q&A
Pro at $12 per user per month annually covers both dictation and meeting notes
MCP access lets Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor read meeting notes and transcripts
SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 apply on every plan
cons: Free plan has a weekly meeting limit; the plan list also mentions 30-day meeting history on desktop
SSO and HIPAA BAA require Growth or Enterprise
No Android notetaker yet, and no native CRM integration listed
freePlanDetails: Free: Notetaker with speaker identification, a weekly meeting limit (recordings under 5 minutes do not count), questions about any meeting and MCP access. Dictation has a weekly word limit. No credit card.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Weekly meeting limit for Notetaker and weekly word limit for dictation.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per user. Unlimited Notetaker history and higher meeting limits. 50% student and 40% educator discounts.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Per user. Unlimited Notetaker, SAML SSO, org-wide HIPAA enforcement with BAA, admin tools. The pricing page also shows a second, unlabeled set of figures ($33 monthly, $26 annual); the comparison table lists $18.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Annual only. SCIM, audit logs, MDM deployment, enforced privacy mode, dedicated support with SLAs. Notetaker listed as an add-on.

integrations: Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack huddles; calendar and Slack context; MCP for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other agents

launch.what: Wispr launched Notetaker, its first product beyond dictation, on Mac; Windows and iPhone versions followed.

name: talat
tagline: Private meeting notes app that transcribes and summarizes on your own computer.
bestFor: Privacy-focused users who want meeting notes that never leave their device
description: talat records the microphone and system audio during Zoom, Teams, Meet or any other call, transcribes on-device and writes a summary with a local model or your own API key. No bot and no account are needed. It costs $89 per year or $189 for a lifetime license.
pros: Transcription runs on-device and recordings are stored in a local database
No meeting bot and no account required
Lifetime license for $189 as an alternative to the $89 yearly plan
Exports to Markdown, Obsidian and PDF, with webhooks and a built-in MCP server
cons: Mac version needs Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later
No compliance certifications listed and no SSO
Teams plan needs at least 3 seats
freePlanDetails: No free plan. The trial gives 10 hours of recording with all features, no account or credit card. After that you can still search, export and summarize existing meetings but cannot record new ones.

plans.name: Monthly
plans.notes: The comparison table says "From $9/mo"; the monthly toggle did not show a separate price in the page text.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: $89 per seat per year, minimum 3 seats.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: MDM deployment or custom builds on request.

integrations: Auto-detects Zoom, Teams and Meet, records any app including FaceTime; Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook (experimental); Markdown, Obsidian and PDF export; webhooks; MCP; bring your own model (Claude, OpenAI, Ollama, Qwen)

sources.label: TechCrunch: Talat's AI meeting notes stay on your machine

name: TwinMind
tagline: AI note taker that captures meetings and conversations from your phone, desktop and browser without a bot.
bestFor: Individuals who want notes from both online meetings and in-person conversations
description: TwinMind captures audio in the background on iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and Chrome, then writes summaries, daily digests and answers about past conversations. No bot joins calls. A free plan is available, and Pro costs $11.99 per month billed annually.
pros: Free plan includes transcription, AI summaries, AI chat and daily digests
Apps for iOS, Android, Mac, Windows and a Chrome extension
MCP access to ChatGPT and Claude on every plan
cons: Monthly-billing prices are not shown on the pricing page
Speaker separation is limited to the Max plan
SOC 2 is listed only for Enterprise, and SSO and HIPAA are not mentioned
freePlanDetails: Free: AI summaries, AI chats, daily digests and recaps, transcription, MCP access capped at 5 tool calls per day. No credit card, does not expire. The page does not state a transcription cap.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: MCP capped at 5 tool calls per day.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Billed annually. Unlimited transcription, ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude models, MCP with 10 tool calls per day, Apple Watch capture, uploads up to 20 hours per day. Monthly-billing price not shown.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: Billed annually, labeled 40% off. 5x limits, speaker separation, auto-tagging and draft emails, unlimited MCP, priority support. Monthly-billing price not shown.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom limits, admin controls, SOC 2 compliance, dedicated support.

integrations: Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams via desktop apps and Chrome extension; calendar and email connections; MCP for ChatGPT, Claude and other tools; Apple Watch capture
